target_profile.system_boundary: Captured Go raft library, RawNode/Node interfaces, log and progress machinery; callers supply persistence, transport and application execution.
protocol_contexts: Per-node term, role, log, progress tracker and configuration
Synchronous Ready/Advance and asynchronous storage messages

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Per-voter Match supports majority or joint-majority commit candidates, qualified by current log term. Append verification and persistence-dependent responses establish support.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Term and role dispatch qualify votes and messages; campaign admission, quorum checks and bounded leadership-transfer attempts govern acquisition and loss of authority.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Append probing and snapshots resynchronize participants; snapshot ConfState is reconstructed through the configuration changer.
Applied entries change membership through Simple or joint transitions; automatic joint exit is an internally generated proposal.
Ready delivers committed work with application ordering and local storage restrictions; completion is separately acknowledged.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Storage supplies persistent history and state; Ready/Advance or ordered storage workers mediate durable responses and recovery.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: ReadState correlates a request context and index; callers wait for application, retry lost requests, persist data and transport messages.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current term and current progress tracker
behaviors.trigger: MsgAppResp accepted by Step and leader dispatch
implementation_guards: Progress must exist; Step filters obsolete terms; commit candidate must match current term.
reads: Current voter sets and per-peer Match. Joint commitment takes the lesser index supported by each constituent majority; learners outside voters do not contribute.
writes: Progress.Match on successful update; log.committed if quorum candidate passes term check.
external_effects: On advancing commit, release pending read requests and broadcast append; otherwise may send commit update to follower.

behaviors.trigger: Campaign, vote response, higher-term traffic, same-term leader traffic
implementation_guards: Campaign admission requires voter progress, no pending snapshot, and no committed unapplied configuration entries.
Only the first vote from each identity is recorded; result uses configured voter sets and both majorities when joint.
writes: Ordinary candidacy increments term and votes for self; reset clears votes, progress, readOnly state and leadership transfer.
important_branches: Pre-candidate does not increment term; granted future pre-vote responses do not force follower transition.
Older messages normally return without role dispatch; stale storage append response still completes snapshot application.
Pre-current-term read messages survive reset, but acquire a fresh committed index and fresh quorum acknowledgments when later released. In-flight readOnly acknowledgments are discarded by reset.
async_boundaries: Self-vote is queued through msgsAfterAppend before vote accounting.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader message term admitted by Step; local committed prefix
implementation_guards: Match previous entry term before append; reject conflict with committed entries.
writes: Append conflicting suffix; advance commit at most to last new index.
external_effects: Queue successful or rejected append response through durability-dependent send.

behaviors.protocol_context: Ready batch and local storage completion
behaviors.trigger: Ready production, Advance or local append response
async_boundaries: Async Ready wraps dependent responses in ordered local append work. Sync Ready exports peer responses and defers self responses until Advance.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Append support is emitted after caller completes the associated storage work.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Vote responses share this delay; stale entry completion is term filtered to prevent unstable truncation after a later-term overwrite.

unknowns: Conflicting same-batch send ordering statements in doc.go and Ready.Messages need applicability resolution.

implementation_guards: Ignore index at or below commit; require follower and recipient membership; matching log fast-forwards commit instead of restoring snapshot.
reads: confchange.Restore reconstructs incoming and outgoing configurations through Simple then EnterJoint; voter/learner compatibility is checked.
writes: Restore log committed boundary and unstable snapshot, reconstruct progress via confchange.Restore.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Snapshot supplies committed history and reestablishes participating configuration.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Recovery restores membership used for future authority acquisition.

behaviors.protocol_context: Applied configuration and current leader progress
legal_preconditions: Caller applies a committed configuration entry in application order.
implementation_guards: Simple changes alter at most one voter; EnterJoint preserves the outgoing set; LeaveJoint removes outgoing-only participants and activates staged learners.
writes: Replace tracker configuration/progress and learner status.
important_branches: Removed or demoted leader optionally steps down and returns.
Remaining leader reevaluates commitment; advancing commit broadcasts append without the pending-read release call in MsgAppResp.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Changing voter aggregation can advance commitment using existing progress.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Removal can terminate authority depending on stepDownOnRemoval.

unknowns: Whether a legal history can make configuration installation cause the first current-term commit despite campaign admission guards remains a local question.

behaviors.protocol_context: Committed, applying, applied and stable boundaries
implementation_guards: Pending or in-progress snapshot blocks committed entry delivery.
Async mode caps applicable index at locally stable prefix; sync mode allows unstable entries under Ready caller ordering.
external_effects: Ready provides committed entries; accepting Ready marks applying, while completion response or Advance accounts application.
async_boundaries: Node serializes input, configuration application, Ready acceptance and Advance in one select loop. While sync Ready awaits Advance, other input and configuration calls can still run.
Async apply responses use Term=0 because committed application is not term-scoped.
unknowns: Early Advance before configuration application is allowed by general Advance prose; how callers preserve configuration-specific ordering remains a local contract question.

writes: Initialize unstable offset beyond stored last index; initialize application and commit at compacted boundary; restore ConfState, load HardState, optionally advance Applied, then become follower.
Bootstrap requires empty log and peers; creates committed configuration entries while leaving application delivery outstanding.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Durable committed prefix constrains future append and application.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Restored term, vote and membership constrain elections; volatile votes and progress are reset.

behaviors.protocol_context: ReadOnlySafe or lease mode, request context, term and applied index
behaviors.trigger: ReadIndex admission, append-response commit, or heartbeat quorum
implementation_guards: Non-singleton leader defers until a current-term entry is committed. Safe mode records leader self acknowledgment and uses configured voter quorum for heartbeat acknowledgments.
important_branches: Singleton answers directly. Safe read queue can release earlier requests when a later context reaches quorum. Reset discards readOnly state, while pre-commit requests can survive and be reprocessed at a later committed index.
ReadIndex interface allows request loss and places retry responsibility on caller; caller correlates RequestCtx and waits for application past index.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Consumes committed prefix rather than creating a log decision.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Heartbeat support confirms authority for safe reads; term dispatch rejects obsolete responses.

unknowns: Version-dependent retry context prose is not resolved here; use unique contexts when constructing checks.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft leader tick and message handlers
behaviors.trigger: MsgTransferLeader, timeout, authority reset or configuration removal
writes: Set leadTransferee and reset electionElapsed; timeout clears transferee if node remains leader.
New transfer aborts prior target; reset or removal also aborts transfer.
external_effects: Send TimeoutNow only when target Match reaches last index, otherwise send append.
existing_protections: Targets with learner progress are rejected; transfer expires after electionTimeout; normal proposal admission resumes after abort.

implementation_guards: Drop new proposals while leadTransferee is nonzero; removed leader drops proposals.
Configuration validation rejects changes while prior configuration application is outstanding.
external_effects: Accepted proposal appends term/index-tagged entries, schedules self acknowledgment and broadcasts replication.

behaviors.protocol_context: AutoLeave joint configuration, pendingConfIndex, leader role and application completion
implementation_guards: Require AutoLeave, newApplied >= pendingConfIndex and leader role.
external_effects: Attempts empty ConfChangeV2 via Step; logs rejection if transfer blocks it.
important_branches: Attempt has zero payload so quota cannot reject it; leadership transfer can reject it.
Comment expects another applied entry to retrigger after failed transfer, or new leader to leave after successful transfer.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Automatic exit requires proposal admission and commitment of a second configuration entry.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Current transfer authority suppresses the exit proposal; timeout removes the suppression but does not directly call this application callback.

unknowns: Whether any scheduler supplies another application acknowledgment after transfer timeout in an otherwise quiescent healthy quorum.

facts.meaning: The current leader has selected a leadership transferee and blocks ordinary proposal admission until this transfer context is cleared or authority is lost.
facts.validity_context: Leader state with nonzero leadTransferee. A selection is an attempt, not evidence that the target has acquired authority.
facts.durability: Volatile; reset clears the transfer attempt.
facts.recovery: No transfer intent is recovered from Storage; restarted node begins as follower.
unknowns: The scheduling of previously rejected internal proposals after timeout is not implied by clearing this field.

facts.meaning: The local raft log records a committed prefix through committed; this is a decision boundary, not completed application or a guarantee that this node has already persisted the prefix.
facts.validity_context: Local log history: leader acknowledgment/configuration paths require current-term quorum candidate; follower appends use leader commitment bounded by matching appended range; snapshot and startup restore recorded committed history.
facts.durability: HardState.Commit and snapshot metadata persist the boundary through the caller storage contract; an in-memory update precedes completion of that work.
facts.recovery: newRaft loads HardState after initializing compacted prefix and restores membership from Storage.
unknowns: Detailed out-of-band snapshot/storage caller policies remain external interface assumptions.

surfaces.reason: Usage permits sending messages during same-batch entry persistence, while Ready.Messages requires entry persistence first. Dependent append acknowledgments share Messages in sync mode; determine authoritative caller requirement before any experiment.
Both paths may advance commit, but only append-response path calls releasePendingReadIndexMessages. Need legal first-current-term-commit history and read completion contract.

surfaces.entry_point: raft.appliedTo automatic joint exit during transfer
surfaces.reason: Application completion attempts an automatic exit proposal, transfer admission rejects it, and timeout only clears the transfer field. Investigate legal overlap and independent wakeup without assuming a liveness violation.

formation.explanation: Leader appends proposals with term and index and queues its own persistence-dependent acknowledgment. Follower verifies log prefix, appends a nonconflicting suffix and queues an acknowledgment. Leader consumes successful progress, asks tracker for committed candidate, and commits only a matching current-term entry. Commit updates propagate by append; committed entries are delivered through Ready with snapshot and local stability restrictions. Tracker aggregates only configured voters: majority takes the quorum-order statistic of Match; joint configuration takes the minimum of both majorities. Leader heartbeat commit is capped at recipient Match. Followers recover missing prefixes through probes or snapshots, and application remains separate from commit.

context.explanation: Campaign changes role and normally increments term; self-vote waits for persistence. Candidate polls responses of the matching election type and becomes leader on VoteWon. Higher-term messages normally step down; pre-vote has explicit exceptions. Reset clears progress and readOnly tracking; obsolete messages are filtered, with explicit snapshot completion handling for stale local append responses. Campaign admission checks voter eligibility, pending snapshot and unapplied committed configurations. Timer-driven quorum checks can step a leader down. Transfer attempts block proposals until target catch-up and TimeoutNow, authority loss, target removal or election-timeout abort. Startup restores term/vote/configuration and durable log while starting as follower.

connection.explanation: Term filtering, reset of progress and the current-term commit condition connect eligible support to authority. Durable log and committed snapshot state survive role transitions while transient vote and progress accounting resets. Configuration installation replaces aggregation context and can itself advance commitment. Ready separates delivery from storage and application completion. Configuration changes activate on application; joint decisions require both voter sets. Removing a voter preserves its progress while it remains in the outgoing set. Committed entries and application completions are term-independent, but volatile replication support and votes are reset. Old pre-commit read requests may be retried internally with fresh authority checks; already outstanding read quorum state is reset. Node dispatch serializes state mutation while permitting new messages and configuration application during a pending Ready.

open_details: Configuration-induced commit versus deferred read release.
Automatic joint exit can be rejected during transfer; existence of another completion trigger after timeout is unresolved.
General early-Advance permission versus configuration-application ordering remains a local boundary.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation, authority transitions, history reconstruction, membership and completion are now connected by read callers/callees. Local anomalies remain explicit and are not claimed as resolved.
